#  13184 - Advanced Seminar Cognitive and Dependable Systems Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13184 - module is no longer offered from SS 2024**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Advanced Seminar Cognitive and Dependable Systems**  |  
|  Oberseminar Cognitive and Dependable Systems   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. habil. Cunningham, Douglas 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 6 semesters  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | The students are enabled to present and discuss scientific papers related to their PhD study. They have furher developed their skills and competencies, e.g. scientific research and analysis skills, communication skills, problem-solving skills, competencies for concept development and project management.  |  
| Contents:  | This module is concerned with varying contents according to the PhD study of the individual students. The state of the art of the different topic is presented, e.g. papers and topics from the current state of the art in research and development in areas related to cognitive and dependable systems, largely stemming from computer science, mathematics, and electrical engineering.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 6 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Will be presented in the first course of each semester.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Three presentations, each one 45 minutes (33.3%)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme Cognitive and Dependable Systems, Ph.D.: manditory module

 |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Every Term: Advanced Seminar „Cognitive and Dependable Systems“ with one hour per week

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 02.11.2023 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
